# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old by the end of Volume 3  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c38 P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)</sub>
- **Rank:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c38 P24](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0024)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher at Pale Sands; formerly a student at Regent's Academy  <sub>[v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c38 P24](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0024)</sub>
- **Titles:** Captain of the Freshman football team  <sub>[v1 c23 P14](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0014)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is a tall, handsome youth with wavy chestnut hair, mischievous light-brown eyes, and a broad, open countenance. He has a very defined, magnificent chin.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c18 P14](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0014), [v1 c19 P47](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0047)_

## Personality

Hugh is high-spirited, cheerful, and full of energy, with a penchant for teasing and playful pranks. He possesses a strong determination to excel academically and ambition for the future, desiring to make a meaningful contribution to the world by becoming a doctor. Despite a stubborn streak and pride, he is honorable, honest, and quick to take responsibility for his misdeeds. He can be deeply devoted and patient in his affections.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c18 P14](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0014), [v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 c30 P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025), [v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)_

## History

After returning to Brierley from a summer in New Brunswick, Hugh re-entered the local school and provoked Nell Harcourt by teasing her about her red hair, leading her to break a slate over his head. Though he apologized, Nell held a grudge against him. Shortly after, Hugh took the blame when Mr. Pidgeon forced Nell to sit next to him as punishment for arriving late. Throughout his school years, he competed fiercely with Nell academically, moving up together into the fourth and fifth readers and mastering advanced subjects. He later attended Regent's Academy, where he was elected Captain of the Freshman football team, earned his First Class License, and won the academic gold medal tied with Nell. In an effort to help Nell remain at Grey Shutters with her ailing aunt, Hugh selflessly withdrew his application for the Brierley schoolmaster position and accepted the post at Pale Sands instead. After years of unrequited affection, Hugh eventually reconciled with Nell, and the two agreed to become close friends and future partners.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c23 P14](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0014), [v1 c32 P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040), [v1 c38 P37](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0037), [v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Brierley, where his father fell ill and spent three years in Alberta for health reasons, taking Hugh with him  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- Spent a summer in New Brunswick visiting cousins prior to returning to school in Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- Attended Regent's Academy alongside Nell Harcourt and earned a First Class Teacher's License  <sub>[v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061)</sub>
- His mother's family line has a history of independence and strong-willed temperaments  <sub>[v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>
